home_title: Tiny Desk AI Video Generator | Outstanding Tiny Desk AI
home_description: Tiny Desk AI demo: put yourself, your friends or the group chat into a mock dog-band video. 1 to 5 people, AI-generated sample output.
home_viral_warriors_hook: Same stage, generated by the demo.
home_origin_2023_text: NPR Music posts Charlie Wilson's Tiny Desk concert. He closes the set with “Outstanding”, the 1982 Gap Band hit.
home_origin_2026_text: The viral trend swaps people into the last 19 seconds of Charlie Wilson's Tiny Desk closer. This demo uses an AI-generated dog band instead of third-party footage.
home_origin_now_text: Your turn. Pick the spots, add the faces, keep the cut and the song.
home_crew_losers_text: Saturday's scores, Sunday's band. Swap in whoever lost and post it before the press conference.
home_crew_rival_text: Five dogs, one desk, same song. The comments write themselves.
home_crew_players_text: Put your team's stars at the desk, singing the encore.
home_crew_you_text: Take a seat yourself and keep the dogs singing backup.
home_crew_chat_text: Or skip the famous faces: the whole chat at the desk.
home_step_cast_text: Tap any dog on stage and add your photo. Swap one or all five; the dogs you don't swap stay on stage.
home_step_make_text: Tick the parody box and press make. It takes a few minutes; you can close the tab.
home_step_post_text: Get the 9:16 MP4 with the song, plus a silent copy for when an app mutes it.
home_faq_what_a: A Tiny Desk AI demo: pick who sings lead, plays sax, keys or backup, add a photo for each, and get a mock dog-band cut back with your picks in it. In the real pipeline the song is mixed on top.
home_faq_people_q: How many people can I put in the video?
home_faq_people_a: Up to five: lead vocals, sax, keys and two backing singers. The stage starts with five dogs; swap one or all five. Spots you don't swap stay dogs, and the price stays the same.
home_faq_cost_a: {plans}. You pay once, there's no subscription, and credits never expire.
home_faq_free_q: Can I try this demo for free?
home_faq_free_a: Yes. This demo build gives a verified signup 20 credits, enough for two mock videos. The real model charges about $3 per render; payments are off in this build.
home_faq_model_q: Which AI model makes the video?
home_faq_model_a: Kuaishou Kling 4.0 in edit mode, at {resolution}: the whole clip in one pass.
home_faq_time_a: Usually 7 to 10 minutes. You can close the tab: sign back in and the video is waiting on the home page.
home_faq_format_q: How long is the video, and what format?
home_faq_format_a: About 18 seconds, a vertical 9:16 MP4 at {resolution} with no watermark: the band, the big laugh close-up, the sax solo and the band again.
home_faq_song_a: The demo returns a generated dog-band sample. In the real pipeline the original track is mixed back in, plus a silent copy.
home_faq_capcut_q: Do I need CapCut, a template or a prompt?
home_faq_capcut_a: No. No editing app, no template file and nothing to type. Tap a spot on the stage, add a photo and press make.
home_faq_photo_a: A recent selfie-style shot: one face, looking at the camera, in good light, nothing covering it. Group photos, sunglasses, cartoons and heavy filters swap badly.
home_faq_celebrity_q: Can I put a celebrity, a coach or a player in it?
home_faq_celebrity_a: In the real pipeline, yes. This demo returns a fixed AI dog-band sample regardless of the uploaded faces, so use it to test the flow, not the likeness.
home_faq_real_q: Is this the real Tiny Desk video?
home_faq_real_a: No. This demo uses an AI-generated dog band as a stand-in. The real product uses rights-cleared footage and the paid Kling/Pruna pipeline.
home_faq_post_q: Can I post it on TikTok or Instagram?
home_faq_post_a: Yes, as a personal, non-commercial parody. The song isn't ours to license, so a platform may mute it; that's what the silent copy is for. Don't pass it off as real or use it in ads.
home_faq_fail_q: What if it fails or doesn't look right?
home_faq_fail_a: If a video can't be made, its credits come back on their own. If someone still looks like the original performer, we re-render them automatically at no extra cost before you get the video. If a finished video is clearly broken, email us within 7 days and we return the credits; see the refund policy. Expect a strong likeness, not a twin.
home_faq_photos_a: We use them only to make your video, send them to our AI video provider for that, and delete them from our storage within 2 days.
home_faq_npr_q: Is this affiliated with NPR or Tiny Desk?
home_faq_npr_a: No. {name} is an independent fan tool for parody videos, not affiliated with or endorsed by NPR, Tiny Desk Concerts, Charlie Wilson or The Gap Band. Tiny Desk is a trademark of NPR.
